claims.claim: Unicode literal can key shape and functionality
claims.reason: The same content-addressed cell co-addresses literal, glyph, evaluator and field action.

claims.claim: Geometry and semantics are identical
claims.reason: They remain typed faces of one record; equality requires an explicit map/certificate.

claims.claim: Set theory can use signed set fields
claims.reason: Exact SDF is one capability; finite, metric, residual and oracle profiles are distinct.

claims.claim: Membership is a local sign query
claims.reason: Under a declared set-field profile, x in A iff phi_A(x)<=0.

claims.claim: Every subset claim is O(1)
claims.reason: Global inclusion is quantified and needs finite exhaustion or a continuous-domain proof.

claims.claim: Converse pairs share one kernel
claims.reason: Surface operand maps and typed endpoints make the reuse exact.

claims.claim: Klein flip is merely a bit shift
claims.reason: The bit selects an involution that also swaps operands and reflects the chart.

claims.claim: Klein-converse preserves truth
claims.reason: E_converse(b,a)=E_direct(a,b) for registered relation pairs.

claims.claim: A half-turn is a Klein reflection
claims.reason: Rotation and orientation-reversing gluing remain distinct profiles.

claims.claim: One bit can be both integrity and topology
claims.reason: Integrity parity and kappa are separate logical and physical fields.

claims.claim: Canonical glyph converse is a mirror
claims.reason: True for the UGTS canonical capsule profile; font-exact profiles may differ.

claims.claim: Unicode codepoint alone fixes font appearance
claims.reason: Font, size, stroke, threshold and rendering policy remain profile data.

claims.claim: Four-bit operator ID is globally unique
claims.reason: It is only a hot codebook slot bound to an atlas hash.

claims.claim: Packed node is complete world state
claims.reason: Definitions, header, lineage, uncertainty and hashes remain external.

claims.claim: One parity bit detects all corruption
claims.reason: It detects odd payload bit flips; CRC/hash layers cover stronger integrity roles.

claims.claim: 32-bit record reduces traffic
claims.reason: Only under a measured workload and an error/equivalence contract.

claims.claim: Eight-bit angle gives 1.40625 degree bins
claims.reason: 360/256 with round-to-nearest maximum half-bin error 0.703125 degrees.

claims.claim: Composed min/max fields remain exact SDFs
claims.reason: Sign is preserved, exact-distance status may be lost.

claims.claim: Sampled LUT proves continuous emptiness
claims.reason: Sampling can miss features between samples unless a certificate closes the gap.

claims.claim: SIMD branchless selection is always faster
claims.reason: Backend choice depends on branch cost, coherence and target measurement.

claims.claim: AVX2 eight-lane extraction is feasible
claims.reason: Correct extraction and full-lane masks are supplied; target throughput remains benchmarked evidence.

claims.claim: Deterministic parity is true randomness
claims.reason: Deterministic bits provide repeatable selection or checks, not entropy.

claims.claim: 16 KB stores arbitrary worlds
claims.reason: Small atlases and repetitive grammars may fit; arbitrary information does not.

claims.claim: This release enumerates all Unicode mathematics
claims.reason: The schema is extensible; the shipped atlas is a bounded set-theory foundation.
